sections.title: design direction
sections.question: Which direction is the product's? Each is a colour, a type scale and a corner radius that go together: one letter sets all three, and each can be changed after.

options.label: workbench: #0246ff, modular, major-second, corner radius small
notes: A tool for working all day: dense rows, close steps of type, small corners. The colour is the owner's.
follows: dense-and-scannable
source_color #0246ff: the colour the owner gave, kept in every direction: a brand colour is the owner's call
type_scale modular: the direction follows dense and scannable, a principle of the catalog the owner has not fixed: related steps let headings stay close to the body text without blurring
type_ratio major-second: the direction follows dense and scannable, a principle of the catalog the owner has not fixed: gentle steps keep many levels of heading on one working screen
corner_radius small: the direction follows dense and scannable, a principle of the catalog the owner has not fixed: small corners keep tight rows and cells from looking crowded
light: primary oklch(0.51 0.274 263.68), the source color itself; 6.31:1 on the background, text on it 6.04:1
dark: primary oklch(0.608 0.211 263.68), moved from the source to reach the contrast ratio; 4.98:1 on the background, text on it 4.51:1

options.label: precise instrument: #0246ff, modular, minor-third, corner radius extra-small
notes: Exact and quiet: nearly square corners, headings that step up clearly. The colour is the owner's.
follows: precise-and-technical, clear-hierarchy
source_color #0246ff: the colour the owner gave, kept in every direction: a brand colour is the owner's call
type_scale modular: the direction follows clear hierarchy, a principle of the catalog the owner has not fixed: every size comes from one ratio, so each step is a visible step
type_ratio minor-third: the direction follows clear hierarchy, a principle of the catalog the owner has not fixed: clear steps that still fit a working screen
corner_radius extra-small: the direction follows precise and technical, a principle of the catalog the owner has not fixed: nearly square corners read as exact without looking unfinished
light: primary oklch(0.51 0.274 263.68), the source color itself; 6.31:1 on the background, text on it 6.04:1
dark: primary oklch(0.608 0.211 263.68), moved from the source to reach the contrast ratio; 4.98:1 on the background, text on it 4.51:1

options.label: familiar: #0246ff, standard, corner radius floor
notes: Looks and behaves the way people already know: the standard sizes, the floor's corner. The colour is the owner's.
follows: familiar-over-novel
source_color #0246ff: the colour the owner gave, kept in every direction: a brand colour is the owner's call
type_scale standard: the direction follows familiar over novel, a principle of the catalog the owner has not fixed: the sizes people have met in many products already
corner_radius floor: the direction follows familiar over novel, a principle of the catalog the owner has not fixed: the corner the floor's components were drawn with
